title: AfterModel input
description: Fires when the response stream of a model request ends without error (provider wrapper). One generation, not a turn. Name from Gemini CLI (sources/gemini-cli-2026-10-30.md:225), where it fires per stream chunk; payload specific to Zed.

request_id.description: Identifier of the model request, shared by BeforeModel, AfterModel and ZedModelError.

intent.description: Zed CompletionIntent of the request, snake_case; null when Zed sets none.

is_compaction.description: True when the request is the compaction summary (recognised by its instruction, not by intent alone).

stop_reason.description: Zed StopReason, snake_case; null if the stream ended without one.

usage.description: Last usage reported by the provider.

duration_ms.description: Time from send to end of stream.
